CORAM:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMIT MAHAJAN  ORDER % 12.08.2024 1.

The present petition is filed seeking quashing of the FIR No. 39/2022, for offences under Section 498A/406/34 of the IPC registered at Police Station Dabri.
2.
The FIR was registered on a complaint given by Respondent No. 2, who alleged cruelty and demand of dowry against her husband and his family members.
3. The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that Petitioner No. 1 is a distant relative and Petitioner Nos. 2 & 3 are sister and brother-in-law of the complainant.
He submits that admittedly the police did not find any material during the course of investigation against the petitioners and their names were kept in column No. 12 in the chargesheet.
This is a digitally signed order.

The learned counsel for Respondent No. 2 appears on advance service and accepts notice on behalf of Respondent No.2.
6.

A copy of the petition be supplied to the counsel for Respondent No. 2.
7.
Reply, if any, be filed before the next date of hearing.
8. Copy of the chargesheet to also be placed on record before the next date of hearing.

9. List on 03.10.2024.
AMIT MAHAJAN, J AUGUST 12, 2024 "SK"
